title: Maximum Earnings From Taxi
summary: Given n points on a road labeled from 1 to n, and a list of passenger rides defined by their start point, end point, and tip amount, determine the maximum earnings you can achieve by optimally picking up passengers.
statement: Given n points on a road labeled from 1 to n, and a list of passenger rides defined by their start point, end point, and tip amount, determine the maximum earnings you can achieve by optimally picking up passengers. You can only drive one passenger at a time and must drive from point 1 to point n without changing direction. For each passenger, you earn endi - starti dollars plus the tipi dollar tip.
constraints: Stops are numbered 1 through n; each ride [start,end,tip] has start<end.
The taxi moves only forward and can carry at most one passenger at a time.
A completed ride earns end-start+tip; maximize total earnings.
reference_solution:
def maximum_taxi_earnings(n,rides):
    rides.sort(key=lambda ride:ride[1]);ends=[];best=[0]
    from bisect import bisect_right
    for start,end,tip in rides:
        prior=bisect_right(ends,start)
        best.append(max(best[-1],best[prior]+end-start+tip));ends.append(end)
    return best[-1]

def maximum_taxi_earnings(n,rides):
    rides.sort(key=lambda ride:ride[1]);ends=[];best=[0]
    from bisect import bisect_right
    for start,end,tip in rides:
        prior=bisect_right(ends,start)
        best.append(max(best[-1],best[prior]+end-start-tip));ends.append(end)
    return best[-1]
hints: This is weighted interval scheduling with compatibility at equal endpoints.
Sort by end; for each ride, binary-search how many earlier rides end by its start.
Every optimum either skips the current ride or takes it after an optimum compatible prefix, so the recurrence covers both exhaustive cases.
